summary_en: The video provides a detailed guide on how to prepare traditional braised pork belly with shrimp paste in a cozy kitchen setting. Two hosts work together to prep ingredients, marinate the pork belly, dissolve the shrimp paste in hot water, and cook the dish on the stove until fragrant, completing the meal with fresh herbs.
